summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 new features (Template picker, Section reordering, Job matcher) + regressions. All new features work correctly end-to-end. PDF download, load-sample, clear-form, ATS widget all functional. localStorage persistence works across reload.

test_results.template_picker: PASS — all 4 templates (modern/klasik/minimal/kompakt) present, aria-pressed toggles, klasik uses Georgia serif, others use Arial sans-serif. Active state (blue ring + check) rendered.
test_results.section_reordering_arrows: PASS — section-down-summary moved 'summary' below 'education'. section-up-experience moved 'experience' above 'summary'. Final order: [education, experience, summary, skills, languages, projects, certificates]. Live preview reflected the new order visually (Eğitim → İş Deneyimi → Profesyonel Profil → Beceriler → Diller → Projeler → Sertifikalar).
test_results.accordion_form_order: PASS — accordion order followed section order: section-personal (fixed first) + [education, experience, summary, skills, languages, projects, certificates].
test_results.job_matcher: PASS — pasting the sample job text produced job-match-result with score %50. Matched: [typescript, docker, react, aws]. Missing chips: [kubernetes, deneyimi, graphql, vue]. Clicking add-keyword-kubernetes added it to Beceriler in the preview (visible: '... AWS • Git • kubernetes') and score increased to %63; kubernetes chip removed from missing.
test_results.persistence: PASS — localStorage 'ats-cv-data-v1' stored template='klasik' and sectionOrder correctly. After reload, active template = template-klasik and section order preserved.
test_results.pdf_download: PASS — pdf-download-button triggered download 'Ahmet_Yılmaz_CV.pdf' with no console errors, after template and section-order changes.
test_results.regressions: PASS — load-sample-button, clear-form-button, ats-score-checker all visible and interactive.

critical_code_review_comments: jobMatch.js stopwords list contains 'deneyim/deneyime/deneyimli' but not the inflected form 'deneyimi', which leaked through as a 'missing' keyword in the sample input. Consider adding 'deneyimi' (and potentially other common Turkish inflections) to TR_STOPWORDS to reduce noise. Non-blocking.

CvPreviewPaper does not expose data-section attributes on rendered sections, so the review-request check to verify preview section order via a testid was done visually via screenshot. Adding data-section='<id>' on each preview section wrapper would make future automation cleaner. Non-blocking.

A 'skills-list' data-testid was not found in the DOM (only the preview's Beceriler paragraph and the form's skill inputs exist). The review request mentions 'visible in skills-list' — functionality is correct (skill appears in preview and is persisted) but a dedicated data-testid='skills-list' on either the preview Beceriler content or the form's skills container would improve testability. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage before test; app auto-loaded default sample data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (template picker, section reorder, job matcher) work correctly. Regressions clean. Only minor code review notes: (1) 'deneyimi' Turkish inflection leaks past stopwords, (2) preview lacks data-section attrs, (3) no skills-list testid — none block the feature.
